title: A function that makes functions
description:
A lambda that captures a value carries that value around with it.

Write `std::function<int(int)> makeAdder(int amount)`. It returns a function which, when called with a number, returns that number plus `amount`.

```cpp
auto addFive{ makeAdder(5) };
addFive(10)    // 15
addFive(-5)    // 0
```

Capture by **value**. By the time the returned function is called, `makeAdder` has finished and its parameter no longer exists, so a reference to it would dangle.
unitTests:
TEST("adds its amount") { const auto addFive{ makeAdder(5) }; CHECK_EQ(addFive(10), 15); CHECK_EQ(addFive(-5), 0); }
TEST("each adder remembers its own amount") { const auto one{ makeAdder(1) }; const auto hundred{ makeAdder(100) }; CHECK_EQ(one(1), 2); CHECK_EQ(hundred(1), 101); CHECK_EQ(one(hundred(0)), 101); }

grading.unitTests:
TEST("adds its amount") { const auto addFive{ makeAdder(5) }; CHECK_EQ(addFive(10), 15); CHECK_EQ(addFive(-5), 0); }
TEST("each adder remembers its own amount") { const auto one{ makeAdder(1) }; const auto hundred{ makeAdder(100) }; CHECK_EQ(one(1), 2); CHECK_EQ(hundred(1), 101); CHECK_EQ(one(hundred(0)), 101); }
